judged_text: The test named "is 404 without an embed_url" never exercises the params.require(:embed_url) branch it claims to verify: with the default blank embeddable_host (config/site_settings.yml line 354: embeddable_host: ''), the ensure_embeddable before_filter raises Discourse::InvalidAccess before the controller action body runs, so get :best fails at the filter, not at the missing param. The missing-embed_url branch is asserted by nothing: if params.require(:embed_url) were deleted entirely (or if the filter order changed so the param check surfaced as a 500 instead of the promised 404), this test still passes because 'response.should_not be_success' is true for any error status — the spec name and the behavior it verifies are unrelated, giving false confidence that the embed_url contract is tested.

adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController, `before_filter :ensure_embeddable` runs before the `best` action’s `params.require(:embed_url)`. `ensure_embeddable` raises `Discourse::InvalidAccess` when `SiteSetting.embeddable_host.blank?` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb), and the default in config/site_settings.yml is `embeddable_host: ''` (blank). In the spec `it "is 404 without an embed_url" do; get :best; response.should_not be_success; end`, no `embeddable_host` stub is set, so the request can fail in the before_filter rather than exercising the missing-param check. Also, the assertion only checks non-success, so it would still pass even if `params.require(:embed_url)` were removed. This is a concrete, diff-grounded test quality issue (misleading/insufficient test), not a direct functional defect in the application logic.
